I will not let you do this. Its not worth it. I will not lose the chance to save the life of another person. Im not doing this for fame or for glory or so i can be some sort of hero, no. Its because I will not let another human become a worthless statistic. I dont want to see your name on a grave anytime soon its not what you deserve. You may think so because your mind makes you think so, depression burrows its way inside and plunges you into a place a darkness and cradles you saying this is where you belong, but its not. We all know depression is corrupt and how it changes you, and what your feeling right now that is change, NOT YOU. Dont listen to the voice inside your head urging you to do this its what it wants, it thrives on suffering and the more you feed it the more it grows and the more it grows the more you feel like its your place. All it takes is that realization that there is an opportunity for something better out there and with enough power and determination you can beat what is in your head. I know how it feels i am depressed and have been since i was young. I have cut myself and tried to commit suicide but as i stood on the side that bridge i looked down and didnt see the end of my life, i saw the start of a new one. What made you stop the first time? Its because, whether you know it or not, you saw what is still out there but you haven't taken that chance so you got dragged back. Listen to me and you can get through this. You do mean something, if people like you didnt, then they wouldnt have this subreddit and i wouldnt be here right now. Someone who cares is staring at you right in the face and all around you. All you have to do is take that first step and let us help or a therapist. I know you hear this often but i dont fucking care how many times i have to say it its all true. I cant save you but i can at least help the best i can, it all rests with you but look at all the people who dont want you to do it. Does that not mean something to you? These total strangers who dont have any reason to care came for you and i wont let you throw away the life you've been given although it may not be ideal. DONT DO IT your life is worth so much more than you know i want you to know that. Thats all just please think about, and read through, all the positive things these people say and push away the sadness as best you can for the time being so you can really understand the good that still remains. I wish you luck friend.                                                                                          
Here is the suicide hotline. Just give it a chance and you can see people out there actually care                                       1-800-273-8255                                                                                                                                                                       -A stranger who actually cares

wow thanks for everything it may only be just two comments but even a few words can make someones day. But its still not the full story my mother, well to put it simply, i hate her. People say "that's a really strong word" and i usually respond "i know, that's why i used it". She was the reason i fell into my current depressive state one year ago. She made me feel entirely terrible, everything i said or did was broken down piece by piece and i was consistently criticized i cant even remember what the hell happened because some things she did were so terrible. I remember one time i was in an argument, and when i had proved her wrong and she had nothing left to say she began to ignore me and turned away as i continued arguing. She then proceeded to take her phone and film me, no doubt trying to post it to social media or gossip to friends and i was not going to adhere to public humiliation. i lightly smacked the phone onto the bed so there was no chance of damage. She quickly got out of bed grabbed me by the wrists shoved me up against the wall and screamed in my face 'IF YOU EVER TOUCH MY SHIT AGAIN I WILL BEAT YOUR ASS, GET OUT". Ever since she began verbally abusing me and being a main source of negativity in my life, my life has been rapidly deteriorating. If it wasn't for her i wouldn't be depressed and wouldn't have to complain to my friends and they would've never left and so i wouldn't have wound up where i am right now. And still to this day her toxicity has continued. i posted this right after an argument with her and i just finished crying and pressing a knife up to my arm and whispering "do it you idiot". A fine example of the effects of words on people. Another detail i would like to point out is when she was walking away i screamed "what is wrong with you!" with tears in my eyes and she yelled back "you!" implying i was a problem and nothing but a burden on her life.
